payload.summary: Prepare releases as reviewable metadata-only pull requests before manual publication.
lessons: Update package.json and regenerate src/generated/version.ts together so the bundled CLI and package checks agree on the release version.
Populate a top-level CHANGELOG.md from the merged history since the previous release.
Run release-equivalent checks without publishing, and leave the release pull request open for maintainer inspection.
verification: Run typecheck, tests, lint, build, check:package, and check:publish before confirming or pushing the release PR.
